criteria.originalText: Male or female participants aged 18 to 75 years, inclusive, at the time of screening.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You must be between 18 and 75 years old.

criteria.originalText: Documented diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus for at least 6 months prior to screening.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You must have been diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes for at least 6 months.
criteria.patientQuestion: Have you been diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes for at least 6 months?

criteria.simpleMeaning: Your recent HbA1c blood test result should be between 7.0% and 10.0%.
criteria.patientQuestion: Do you know your most recent HbA1c result, and was it between 7.0% and 10.0%?

criteria.originalText: Participant must be willing and able to attend all study visits over the 24-week treatment period.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You must be able to attend all study visits for 24 weeks.
criteria.patientQuestion: Are you able to attend study visits regularly over a 24-week period?

criteria.originalText: Participant must be able to provide informed consent.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You must be able to understand and sign a consent form.
criteria.patientQuestion: Are you able to understand and provide informed consent for this study?

criteria.simpleMeaning: You should not have a history of Type 1 Diabetes.
criteria.patientQuestion: Have you ever been diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes?

criteria.originalText: Currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study period.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You should not be pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
criteria.patientQuestion: Are you currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study period?

criteria.originalText: Severe renal impairment, defined as estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You should not have severe kidney impairment.
criteria.patientQuestion: Have you been told you have severe kidney (renal) impairment?

criteria.originalText: Currently receiving insulin therapy of any kind.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You should not currently be using insulin therapy.
criteria.patientQuestion: Are you currently taking insulin, or are you unsure about your current diabetes medications?
options: Not sure / unsure of current medications

criteria.originalText: Known hypersensitivity to the investigational drug or its excipients.
criteria.simpleMeaning: You should not have a known allergy to the study drug or its ingredients.
criteria.patientQuestion: Do you have any known drug allergies relevant to diabetes medications?
